questions.explanation: n = k + 1 is the correct step in a proof by mathematical induction.

questions.text: If both the base case and the inductive step of a proof by induction are established, we conclude the statement is true for:
questions.explanation: All positive integers n is the correct step in a proof by mathematical induction.

questions.text: A circle has equation x² + y² - 4x + 6y + F = 0 with center (2,-3) and radius 5. Find F.
questions.explanation: Completing the square gives (x-2)²+(y+3)² = 13 - F, and this equals 25, so F = -12.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the length of the tangent from the point (5,4) to the circle x² + y² = 9.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the eccentricity of the ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the equation of the tangent to the parabola y² = 8x at the point (2,4).
questions.explanation: For y²=4ax with a=2, the tangent at (x₁,y₁) is yy₁=2a(x+x₁): 4y=4(x+2) ⟹ y=x+2.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the foci of the hyperbola x²/16 - y²/9 = 1.
questions.explanation: c² = a²+b² = 16+9 = 25, so c = 5 and the foci are (±5, 0).

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Differentiate y = (3x² + 1)⁵ and find dy/dx at x = 1.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Given y = x² sinx, find dy/dx at x = π/2.
questions.explanation: dy/dx = 2x sinx + x² cosx; at x=π/2, this is 2(π/2)(1) + (π/2)²(0) = π.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Use the quotient rule to differentiate y = (2x - 1)/(x + 3).

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the second derivative of y = x⁴ - 6x² + 2 at x = 1.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Given x² + y² = 25, use implicit differentiation to find dy/dx at the point (3,4).

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the x-coordinate of the local maximum of y = x³ - 3x² - 9x + 5.
questions.explanation: y' = 3x²-6x-9 = 3(x-3)(x+1) = 0 at x=3 or x=-1; y''=6x-6 is negative at x=-1, giving a local maximum there.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: The radius of a circle increases at 2 cm/s. Find the rate of increase of its area when r = 5 cm.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Given f(x) = x² + 3x, use the first-principles derivative f'(x) = 2x + 3 to find f'(2).

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Given y = (x² + 1)³, find dy/dx at x = 2.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the tangent to y = x³ - 2x + 1 at x = 2, and state its y-intercept.
questions.explanation: At x=2, y=5 and y'=3(4)-2=10, so the tangent is y-5=10(x-2), i.e. y=10x-15, giving y-intercept -15.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A closed box with a square base has volume 32 m³. Find its minimum possible surface area.
questions.explanation: With base x and height h=32/x², S = x²+128/x; dS/dx=2x-128/x²=0 gives x=4, so S = 16+32 = 48 m².

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate ∫ from 0 to 2 of (3x² - 4x + 2) dx.
questions.explanation: Antiderivative is x³-2x²+2x; evaluating from 0 to 2 gives (8-8+4)-0 = 4.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Use integration by parts to evaluate ∫ from 0 to 1 of x eˣ dx.
questions.explanation: ∫x eˣ dx = eˣ(x-1) + C; evaluating from 0 to 1: [0] - [-1] = 1.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate ∫ from 1 to 2 of 1/x dx.
questions.explanation: ∫1/x dx = ln x; evaluating from 1 to 2 gives ln2 - ln1 = ln2.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Use substitution to find ∫ (2x + 1)³ dx.
questions.explanation: With u=2x+1, du=2dx: ∫u³ du/2 = u⁴/8 + C = (2x+1)⁴/8 + C.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area under y = x² between x = 1 and x = 3.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area enclosed between y = 4 - x² and the x-axis.
questions.explanation: The curve meets the axis at x=±2; ∫ from -2 to 2 of (4-x²) dx = [4x - x³/3] = 32/3.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: The curve y = x² (0 ≤ x ≤ 2) is rotated about the x-axis. Find the volume generated.
questions.explanation: V = π∫ from 0 to 2 of x⁴ dx = π[x⁵/5] = 32π/5.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate ∫ from 0 to π/2 of sin²x dx.
questions.explanation: Using sin²x=(1-cos2x)/2: [x/2 - sin2x/4] from 0 to π/2 = π/4.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate ∫ from 0 to 1 of 2x/(x²+1) dx.
questions.explanation: With u=x²+1: [ln(x²+1)] from 0 to 1 = ln2 - ln1 = ln2.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Use integration by parts to evaluate ∫ from 0 to π/2 of x cosx dx.
questions.explanation: ∫x cosx dx = x sinx + cosx + C; evaluating from 0 to π/2 gives (π/2 + 0) - (0+1) = π/2 - 1.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate ∫ from 0 to 1 of (3x² + 2x) dx.
questions.explanation: Antiderivative is x³+x²; evaluating from 0 to 1 gives 1+1 = 2.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the mode of the data set 2, 4, 4, 6, 8, 10, 10, 10.
questions.explanation: 10 occurs three times, more than any other value, so the mode is 10.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the median of the data set 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 15.
questions.explanation: With n=6, the median is the average of the 3rd and 4th values: (8+10)/2 = 9.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the variance of the data set 2, 4, 6, 8, 10.
questions.explanation: Mean=6; squared deviations are 16,4,0,4,16, summing to 40, and 40/5 = 8.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the standard deviation of the data set 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 (variance = 8).

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A frequency distribution has scores 10 (freq 3), 20 (freq 5), 30 (freq 2). Find the mean.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: For the data set 3,5,7,9,11,13,15,17, find the lower quartile Q1.
questions.explanation: Position = (n+1)/4 = 2.25, between the 2nd (5) and 3rd (7) values: Q1 = 5 + 0.25(7-5) = 5.5.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the range of the data set 12, 7, 15, 22, 9, 18.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A data set of 10 values has mean 20 and variance 25. If every value is increased by 5, find the new variance.
questions.explanation: Adding a constant to every value shifts the mean but leaves the variance unchanged, so it remains 25.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: In how many ways can 5 people be arranged in a row if two particular people must sit together?
questions.explanation: Treat the pair as one unit: 4! arrangements × 2! for the pair = 48.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A committee of 4 is chosen from 7 men and 5 women. Find the number of ways if it must contain exactly 2 women.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Find the number of distinct arrangements of the letters of the word STATISTICS.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Two fair dice are rolled. Find the probability that the sum is 8.
questions.explanation: The pairs (2,6),(3,5),(4,4),(5,3),(6,2) give 5 outcomes out of 36.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A bag contains 5 red and 3 blue balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. Find the probability both are red.

questions.text: A binomial random variable has n=10 and p=0.2. Find its variance.

questions.text: From a group of 8 people, a committee of 3 is selected such that one particular person must be included. Find the number of possible committees.
questions.explanation: The remaining 2 members are chosen from the other 7: C(7,2) = 21.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A body of mass 4 kg is acted on by two opposing forces of 10N and 6N. Find its acceleration.
questions.explanation: Net force = 10-6 = 4N, so a = F/m = 4/4 = 1 m/s².

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A 2 kg body moving at 5 m/s is brought to rest in 2 seconds by a constant force. Find the magnitude of the impulse.
questions.explanation: Impulse = change in momentum = m(v-u) = 2(0-5) = -10, magnitude 10 Ns.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A machine does 4000 J of work in 8 seconds. Find its power.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A particle is in equilibrium under three forces: 10N, 10√3N, and F. The angle opposite F is 90°, opposite 10√3N is 120°, and opposite 10N is 150°. Find F using Lami's theorem.
questions.explanation: By Lami's theorem, 10/sin150° = 10√3/sin120° = F/sin90° = 20, so F = 20 N.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Two forces of 8N and 6N act at right angles to each other on a particle. Find the magnitude of the resultant.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A body of weight 50N rests on a smooth plane inclined at 30° to the horizontal, held by a force parallel to the plane. Find this force.
questions.explanation: For equilibrium along the plane, F = W sin30° = 50(0.5) = 25 N.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: A uniform ladder of weight 200N rests with its foot on rough ground and top against a smooth wall, inclined at 60° to the horizontal. Find the horizontal reaction from the wall.
questions.explanation: Taking moments about the foot: N(2Lsin60°) = 200(Lcos60°), so N = 200cos60°/(2sin60°) = 100/√3 ≈ 57.7 N.

questions.subject: Further Mathematics
questions.text: Two like parallel forces of 15N and 25N act on a rod 8m apart. Find the distance of their resultant from the 15N force.
questions.explanation: Taking moments about the 15N force: 25×8 = 40×x, so x = 200/40 = 5 m.
